title: Postselection-Free Reconstruction of Monitored SPT Flux-Charge Responses
summary: A class of monitored topological invariants compares ordinary and symmetry-twisted quantum trajectories with identical stochastic records, so direct estimation requires exponentially costly matched-record postselection. We replace the twisted quantum experiment by uniformly randomized symmetry eigenstates with known charges, ordinary-boundary monitoring, and an offline twist decoder. Their correlation yields an exact finite-time response identity and removes this experimental sampling bottleneck.
